news.title: TradFi fund manager Baillie Gifford introduces Solana, Ethereum tokenized fund with BNY
news.summary: Baillie Gifford Enhanced Yield Fund (BAGEY) is denominated in dollars, and gives eligible investors access to an actively managed, short-duration portfolio of public corporate bonds.

news.title: Strategy added $35 million in bitcoin, $300 million in cash reserves last week
news.summary: The boost to cash reserves is meant to reassure investors about dividend payments on the company's hard-hit preferred shares, STRC.

news.title: Bitcoin mining network becoming more sensitive to price swings, JPMorgan says
news.summary: A growing share of miners are operating near breakeven levels, making hashrate and mining difficulty increasingly responsive to bitcoin's price movements, the bank said.

news.title: Bitmine added $92 million of ETH, with Tom Lee continuing to believe in 'crypto spring'
news.summary: The largest Ethereum treasury firm slowed its buying pace but remains on track to reach its goal of owning 5% of ETH supply.

news.title: OKX and NYSE partner to bridge tradfi and crypto markets in joint venture led by Andrew Cuomo
news.summary: The goal is to enable OKX’s 120 million global users to access ICE futures and NYSE tokenized equities markets, the two U.S. companies announced.

news.title: Crypto's second U.S. lobbying front — tax policy — sees industry push on mining, staking
news.summary: The crypto sector's leading U.S. advocacy groups asked the U.S. House's tax committee to advance a bill to clarify treatment of assets from mining and staking.

news.title: Ethereum Foundation talent exodus sparks fresh debate over leadership
news.summary: The Ethereum community is once again debating the future of the foundation after co-executive director Hsiao-Wei Wang announced she would step down.

news.title: Ether’s biggest corporate holders back new Ethereum research hub
news.summary: Ethlabs was formed with support from SharpLink, Bitmine and Consensys CEO Joe Lubin as the network's development is expanding beyond the Ethereum Foundation.

news.summary: Gain insight on Experian, SoFi Technologies and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

news.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
news.summary: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.
